# vcp_dns_domains (Data Source)

Fetches all DNS domains (zones) in the project, each including its record sets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all DNS zones in the project.
data "vcp_dns_domains" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Attributes List) All zones in the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `is_delegated` (Boolean) Whether the zone is delegated.
- `name` (String) Zone name (FQDN).
- `record_sets` (Attributes List) Record sets in the zone, grouped by name and type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains--record_sets))

<a id="nestedatt--domains--record_sets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains.record_sets`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Record set name (FQDN).
- `protocol` (String) SRV protocol (null for other types).
- `service` (String) SRV service (null for other types).
- `ttl` (String) TTL shared by the whole record set.
- `type` (String) Record type (A, AAAA, MX, CNAME, NS, TXT, SRV).
- `values` (Attributes Set) Values (rdata) of the record set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains--record_sets--values))

<a id="nestedatt--domains--record_sets--values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains.record_sets.values`

Read-Only:

- `canonical_name` (String) Canonical name (CNAME).
- `ip` (String) IPv4/IPv6 address (A/AAAA).
- `mail_host` (String) Mail host (MX).
- `name_server_host` (String) Name server host (NS).
- `port` (Number) Port (SRV).
- `priority` (Number) Priority (MX/SRV).
- `target` (String) Target (SRV).
- `text` (String) Text (TXT).
- `weight` (Number) Weight (SRV).
